title: Parking
description: A parking option belonging to the property. Not modelled as a room, because parking does not count towards the layout or usable area of the unit.

@type.description: Must be or contain `erdif:Parking`, usually next to a schema.org type.

count.description: Number of spaces of this type. Defaults to 1.

includedInPrice.description: Flag indicating whether parking is included in the main price.
